ROLE: Decode a complete CONNECT packet: validate the fixed header flags, protocol name, connect flags and field presence, and borrow the client identifier, user name and password slices.

SIGNATURE.RAW: enum wire_status wire_decode_connect(const uint8_t *packet, size_t len, struct wire_connect *out)
SIGNATURE.NAME: wire_decode_connect

STRUCT.NAME: struct wire_connect
STRUCT.ROLE: decoded CONNECT fields, all slices borrowed from packet

STRUCT.NAME: struct wire_span
STRUCT.ROLE: borrowed slice of client identifier, user name or password

FUNC.NAME: wire_declared_body_len
FUNC.ROLE: confirm len is exactly the declared frame size

FUNC.NAME: wire_decode_string
FUNC.ROLE: read the length-prefixed protocol name, client id, will topic, user name and password fields

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: wire_declared_body_len
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: static enum wire_status wire_declared_body_len(const uint8_t *packet, size_t len, size_t *header_len, size_t *remaining_length)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: WIRE_COMPLETE with header_len (2..5) and remaining_length when len equals header_len + remaining_length; WIRE_INCOMPLETE when fewer bytes than declared are buffered; WIRE_INVALID for an unusable Remaining Length field or a buffer longer than the declared frame
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: no ownership transfer; the packet stays with the caller
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: any result other than WIRE_COMPLETE means the caller must return WIRE_INVALID without writing out

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: wire_decode_string
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: static int wire_decode_string(const uint8_t *packet, size_t len, size_t *pos, struct wire_span *out, int validate_utf8)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 with *pos advanced by 2 + field length and *out = borrowed slice; 0 when the field runs past len (cursor unchanged); -1 when the field is complete but not valid UTF-8
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: the returned span borrows bytes from packet and must not outlive it
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: results 0 and -1 both mean the CONNECT packet is malformed, so the caller returns WIRE_INVALID

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: wire_read_u16
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: no failure under documented preconditions (the caller has already verified that two bytes remain)

LOGIC.INPUT: packet with len bytes holding exactly one framed CONNECT (the caller obtained len from wire_decode_header.total_len); out receiving the decoded fields.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) If packet is NULL or out is NULL return WIRE_INVALID. 2) Zero *out. 3) wire_declared_body_len(packet, len, &header_len, &rl); if it is not WIRE_COMPLETE return WIRE_INVALID (a decoder never runs on a partial packet, and a short buffer must not be reported as incomplete). 4) Fixed header flags: if (packet[0] & 0x0F) != 0 return WIRE_INVALID (CONNECT reserved flags, fact F003). 5) pos = header_len. Protocol name: wire_decode_string(packet, len, &pos, &span, 1) must return 1, span.len must be 4 and the bytes must be 4D 51 54 54 ('MQTT'); otherwise return WIRE_INVALID. 6) Protocol level: pos must be < len, else WIRE_INVALID; out->protocol_level = packet[pos++]. The value is stored verbatim: a level other than 4 is well formed and is refused later with CONNACK 0x01, never here. 7) Connect flags: require 2 bytes; flags = packet[pos++]; if (flags & 0x01) return WIRE_INVALID (reserved bit 0). will_qos = (flags >> 3) & 0x03; if will_qos == 3 return WIRE_INVALID (reserved Will QoS). If (flags & 0x40) and !(flags & 0x80) return WIRE_INVALID (password flag requires the user name flag). If ((flags >> 2) & 0x01) == 0 and (will_qos != 0 || (flags & 0x20) != 0) return WIRE_INVALID (with the Will flag clear the Will QoS and Will Retain flags MUST be zero, fact F019; such a packet is malformed and must be closed without a CONNACK, facts F017/F058). out->clean_session = (flags >> 1) & 0x01; out->has_will = (flags >> 2) & 0x01; out->has_password = (flags >> 6) & 0x01; out->has_user_name = (flags >> 7) & 0x01. 8) Keep Alive: require 2 bytes, out->keep_alive = wire_read_u16(packet + pos), pos += 2. 9) Client identifier: wire_decode_string(..., 1) must return 1; store the span in out->client_id (empty identifier is stored and refused by broker policy, so the wire decoder does not invent a length rule). 10) If out->has_will: read the Will Topic with UTF-8 validation and the Will Message as a binary field (validate_utf8 = 0); both must decode, both are validated then skipped - the broker does not accept a Will, so no will bytes are retained. 11) If out->has_user_name: decode the user name with UTF-8 validation into out->user_name. 12) If out->has_password: decode the password as a binary field into out->password. 13) If pos != len return WIRE_INVALID (bytes after the last field of the packet). 14) Return WIRE_COMPLETE. Every borrowed span points into packet, which the caller must keep alive until it has copied what it needs (only the client identifier is copied, by session_set_client_id).
LOGIC.OUTPUT: WIRE_COMPLETE with *out filled from the packet: protocol_level, clean_session, keep_alive, has_user_name, has_password, has_will and the borrowed client_id/user_name/password spans; empty fields are reported as spans of length 0 rather than as NULL. WIRE_INVALID for reserved flags, a protocol name other than MQTT, a reserved Will QoS, non-zero Will QoS or Will Retain bits with the Will flag clear (fact F019), a password flag without a user name flag, any truncated field, any ill-formed UTF-8 string field, or trailing bytes. The function never returns WIRE_INCOMPLETE and performs no policy decision: level != 4, an empty/non-ASCII client identifier, a Will or Clean Session = 0 are all decoded successfully so that the caller can answer with the mandated CONNACK or close with the mandated silence.
INVARIANTS_USED: CONNECT is the first packet of a connection
the CONNECT fixed header flags are 0
the protocol name is exactly MQTT
reserved CONNECT flag bit 0 and Will QoS 3 are malformed
a password flag without a user name flag is malformed
a clear Will flag requires Will QoS 0 and Will Retain 0 (fact F019)
fields are present exactly when their flag is set and in protocol order
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: packet holds one complete CONNECT frame of len bytes.
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: *out describes the packet and every span is a borrowed slice inside packet; nothing is allocated.
LOGIC.THREAD_SAFETY: Pure function of its arguments; the packet buffer must not be mutated concurrently.

WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: type must be 1 and the low 4 flag bits must be 0, else WIRE_INVALID (fact F003).
length-prefixed field that must encode exactly 4D 51 54 54; any other name is WIRE_INVALID (facts F009/F010 style: the name is MQTT and the level is 4 for this broker).
stored verbatim (1 byte); the broker answers CONNACK return code 0x01 when it is not 4.

WIRE_MAPPING.WIRE_FIELD: Connect Flags (bit7 user name, bit6 password, bit5 will retain, bits4-3 will QoS, bit2 will flag, bit1 clean session, bit0 reserved)
WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: bit0 must be 0; will QoS 3, will QoS or will retain set while the Will flag is clear (fact F019), and password-without-user-name are rejected as WIRE_INVALID; the Will flag itself is stored, not rejected (its presence is a policy decision for the broker); when the Will flag is set the will retain and will QoS bits are parsed then skipped.
2-byte MSB-first value stored verbatim; no keepalive timeout is implemented by this broker (scope R09).
2-byte length prefix plus that many UTF-8 bytes; no length or character restriction at the wire layer (an empty identifier is a legal UTF-8 string), the ASCII/non-empty rule is broker policy.

present if and only if the Will flag is set, in that order; the topic is a UTF-8 string and the message a length-prefixed binary field; both must be well formed or the packet is WIRE_INVALID, and neither is retained because this broker does not accept a Will (scope R02).
present if and only if the user name flag is set; UTF-8 validated, then ignored by broker policy (anonymous connections only).
present if and only if the password flag is set (which requires the user name flag); arbitrary binary bytes, so no UTF-8 check; ignored by broker policy.
